ad_library.summary: Ray On Solar Systems is running 1 live Meta ad (Library ID 1107666674962232, started 13 October 2026) offering a 3kW solar system with subsidy - and its click goes to Instagram, not to the website. The site has no tracking at all: no Meta Pixel, no GA4, no GTM, and no Google Ads record. The homepage has no enquiry form and no tap-to-call phone links, while every 'Get Started' button points to a /contact/ address that returns a 404 - the site's own free-quote form sits unused while the ad pays for clicks. Rank Math gives the site decent meta tags, but the title still reads 'Suryodhya ghar', never mentions the brand, and the schema markup uses invalid https://schema.org URLs that Google ignores. Meanwhile ~180 live competitor Meta ads and WAAREE's ~200 Google ads are buying the same customers.
